candidate_predicates.name: EXPRESSES_VERIFICATION_INTENT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly states an intention to perform a future verification activity, such as running, testing, comparing, or inspecting something to confirm correctness or reduce uncertainty.

parameters.name: verification_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node expressing the intended future verification.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies at least one future verification action.
The intended action is directed at checking, testing, comparing, or inspecting a result, artifact, or execution path.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports completed verification without expressing a future intention.
The reasoning states a general goal or plan that contains no identifiable verification action.

candidate_predicates.name: REVIEWS_FINAL_ARTIFACT_CONTENT
candidate_predicates.definition: A planned final review of an artifact's content is carried out by retrieving or displaying the artifact, and the retrieved content is made available for confirming the final implementation.

parameters.name: review_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node expressing intent to perform a final review of artifact content.

parameters.name: inspection_action
parameters.description: The action retrieving or displaying the artifact for the final review.

parameters.name: artifact_content
parameters.description: The observation returning the artifact content inspected in the review.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning indicates a final review of an artifact's content after prior checks.
The action retrieves or displays the artifact.
The observation contains the artifact's content.
exclusion_conditions: No final-review intent is expressed.
The action does not retrieve the artifact, or the observation does not contain artifact content.
The review is only planned and not carried out.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_EQUIVALENT_OUTPUTS_FROM_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning concludes that two or more execution paths produce equivalent or identical outputs, using an observation that reports their respective outputs for comparable cases.

parameters.name: equivalence_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node asserting equivalence or consistency of outputs.

parameters.name: output_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting outputs from multiple execution paths.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports outputs from at least two execution paths for comparable cases.
The reasoning asserts that those outputs are identical or equivalent.
exclusion_conditions: Only one execution path is represented in the observation.
The reasoning merely repeats raw outputs without comparing them.
The observation lacks comparable outputs from multiple paths.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_CLEAN_EXECUTION_FROM_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning concludes that compilation, execution, or validation completed successfully without error output, based on outcome details reported in an observation.

parameters.name: clean_execution_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node concluding that execution or validation was clean and successful.

parameters.name: execution_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting exit status, error output, or validation status.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports status or error-output details for the relevant compilation, execution, or validation.
The reasoning concludes successful execution with zero exit status and/or empty error output.
exclusion_conditions: The observation lacks exit-status or error-output information.
The reasoning only reports outputs without judging execution success.
The observation shows a nonzero exit status or nonempty error output.

candidate_predicates.name: CHECKS_SPECIFICATION_CONFORMANCE
candidate_predicates.definition: A validation action is deliberately performed using an exact invocation or interface form required by the specification, and the observation confirms that this specified form works.

parameters.name: specification_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node identifying or asserting the exact required invocation or interface form.

parameters.name: conformance_action
parameters.description: The action executing the exact specified invocation or interface form rather than an adapted proxy.

parameters.name: conformance_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of that exact invocation or interface form.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies or asserts an explicit required invocation or interface form.
The action uses that exact specified form.
The observation reports a successful or valid outcome for that form.
exclusion_conditions: The action uses an alternative command or adapted wrapper instead of the specified form.
No explicit specification or required form is referenced.
The observation does not report the outcome of the exact form.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_CONSISTENT_BEHAVIOR_ACROSS_INPUT_CASES
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning concludes that an operation behaves consistently across multiple representative input values, supported by an action that exercises those inputs and an observation reporting per-input outcomes.

parameters.name: coverage_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node citing or requesting multiple distinct input values as a consistency check.

parameters.name: coverage_action
parameters.description: The action exercising the operation across multiple distinct input values.

parameters.name: coverage_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting per-input outcomes for those values.

assertion_conditions: At least two distinct input values are involved.
The action applies the same operation across those input values.
The observation reports corresponding outcomes for the inputs.
The reasoning uses the per-input outcomes to support consistency or correctness.
exclusion_conditions: Only a single input value is exercised.
Input values are not varied, or the observation lacks per-input results.
The reasoning does not assess consistency across cases.

candidate_predicates.name: EXPLAINS_ARTIFACT_BEHAVIOR_FROM_SOURCE
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explains how an artifact produces different or required behaviors under different execution contexts by interpreting specific source constructs present in an observation of the artifact's content.

parameters.name: explanation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node interpreting source constructs to explain artifact behavior.

parameters.name: source_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the artifact or source content being interpreted.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains source or artifact content.
The reasoning references specific constructs or blocks in that content.
The reasoning explains how those constructs produce the observed or required behavior across execution contexts.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only summarizes test results or restates content without explaining behavior.
The observation does not contain source or artifact content.
No concrete source construct is referenced.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_COMPLETION_IN_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning declares a task complete and bases that declaration on multiple verification observations, such as output comparisons, clean execution, syntax validation, or artifact review.

parameters.name: completion_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node declaring task completion and tying it to verification results.

parameters.name: verification_observations
parameters.description: Homogeneous collection of observations supplying collective verification evidence.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly declares the task or artifact complete.
The reasoning cites or relies on multiple prior verification outcomes.
The observation collection contains those verification outcomes and collectively supports the completion claim.
exclusion_conditions: Completion is only planned or hoped for, not declared.
The completion declaration is not supported by identifiable verification observations.
The observations are unrelated to the completion claim.
